blocks.text: Commerce is a vital part of our economy, influencing daily life and business operations.

blocks.markdown: Commerce encompasses all activities related to the buying and selling of goods and services. It is broader than trade, which focuses solely on the exchange of goods, and includes various aids to trade such as transportation, banking, and insurance.

blocks.title: Definition of Commerce
blocks.text: Commerce is the activity of buying and selling, including all the processes that facilitate these transactions.

blocks.markdown: In Nigeria, commerce plays a crucial role in economic development. It includes home trade (local exchanges), foreign trade (international exchanges), and aids to trade that enhance these processes. Understanding commerce helps us appreciate its impact on job creation and economic growth.

blocks.title: Identifying the Components of Commerce
blocks.prompt: List the main components of commerce and categorize them.

steps.text: Identify the components: Trade, Aids to Trade, and Services.
Categorize them into Home Trade, Foreign Trade, and Aids to Trade.

blocks.answer: 1. Home Trade: Local buying and selling. 2. Foreign Trade: International trade activities. 3. Aids to Trade: Services like banking, insurance, and transportation.

blocks.markdown: The functions of commerce in an economy include facilitating trade, creating jobs, and contributing to national income. By understanding these functions, we can see how commerce supports economic stability and growth.

blocks.title: Exam Tip
blocks.text: Always differentiate between commerce, trade, and industry in your answers to avoid losing marks.

points: Commerce is broader than trade and includes various aids to trade.
